primary_population: Eligible ICU stays with at least one valid typed lactate measurement during ICU hours 0-24 and before death or discharge.
primary_estimand: The adjusted descriptive association between first-24-hour peak lactate and in-hospital death among lactate-measured eligible ICU stays; this is an association, not a treatment or causal effect.
primary_method: Model lactate continuously with logistic regression, report 95% confidence intervals, and compare a linear specification with a prespecified restricted-cubic-spline specification without choosing the form from outcome significance.
reportability_rule: Report the measured-subset association only together with the full-cohort measurement and exposure-opportunity audits; if measurement state, units, timestamps, death, or discharge alignment cannot be verified, no headline association is reportable.
